mapper.insert: insert into user_behavior (user_id, service_item_id, category_id, behavior_type, source, weight, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{serviceItemId}, #{categoryId}, #{behaviorType}, #{source}, #{weight}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select b.id, b.user_id, b.service_item_id, b.category_id, b.behavior_type, b.weight, b.create_time from user_behavior b join (select service_item_id, max(id) as max_id from user_behavior where user_id = #{userId} group by service_item_id) t on b.id = t.max_id order by b.create_time desc limit #{limit}

select b.id, b.user_id, b.service_item_id, b.category_id, b.behavior_type, b.weight, b.create_time from user_behavior b join (select user_id, service_item_id, max(weight) as max_weight from user_behavior where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) group by user_id, service_item_id) t on b.user_id = t.user_id and b.service_item_id = t.service_item_id and b.weight = t.max_weight
